title: ModTheSpire2
description:
ModTheSpire2 is a pre-launch mod selector and restart helper for Slay the Spire 2.

GitHub:
https://github.com/grassdog0/MTS2

Main features:
- Windows launcher with no extra runtime install.
- Choose vanilla, selected mods, load order, and named profiles before the game starts.
- The launcher reads the current settings.save order and enabled state.
- Save updates the named profile. Refresh reloads the selected profile. Current settings.save is a read-only view of the game settings.
- Dependency-aware mod list with compatibility for common Workshop manifest layouts.
- Read-only Better Mod Menu grouping import when available.
- The in-game Launcher button is placed beside Installed Mods and follows the game's native appearance and typography.
- Vanilla starts normally with all mods disabled, preserving the built-in Mod Settings menu. No --nomods argument is added.
- Launch Selected rewrites the complete mod list with the visible checkbox states, so unselected mods do not become enabled after Vanilla.
- Close and Open Launcher forwards renderer flags such as --rendering-driver opengl3.

Windows Steam launch option:
"<path to ModTheSpire2Launcher.exe>" -- %command%
Keep %command% exactly as written. Add extra game arguments after %command%.

Experimental cross-platform preview:
- ModTheSpire2Launcher.sh for native Linux / Steam Deck.
- ModTheSpire2Launcher.command for native macOS Steam.
- These are lightweight script-menu previews, not full GUI launchers. Linux/macOS support has not been verified on real systems yet. Volunteers and feedback are welcome.

Workshop cannot edit Steam launch options automatically. Multiplayer error reporting is provided by the game; MTS2 does not append extra error text.

Latest script fixes: corrected manifest JSON parsing, resolved Steam symlink aliases, scanned multiple Workshop libraries, and added detailed Diagnostics counters and error logs. Automated fixture tests pass; real Linux/macOS game testing is still needed. Volunteers and feedback are welcome.
changeNote:
Multiplayer reporting cleanup and script discovery fixes
- Removed extra MTS2 multiplayer lobby error text, generated reports, and related management/BaseLib buttons. The game now handles error reporting on its own.
- Fixed the shell manifest parser returning zero discovered mods.
- Canonicalized Steam path aliases and scan all discovered Workshop libraries.
- Diagnostics now reports candidates, accepted mods, skipped files, errors, and duplicates.
- Automated Windows/package and shell fixture tests passed. Linux/macOS real-system testing is still pending; volunteers and feedback are welcome.
